# SCI-MAP v0.1 PTC-Handoff Decision Mapping

Date: `2026-08-26`

Status: proposed Stage A traceability; owner approval required

This mapping constrains the bounded revision. It identifies candidate
normative touch points but does not itself amend a requirement or resolve an
owner decision.

| Owner decision | Required contract effect | Existing normative touch points | Owner-ledger effect |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `A2M-OWNER-D001` | Preserve physical occurrence identity while making every independent-exposure judgment component/product/use specific | Review `SCI-MAP-REQ-003`, `004`, `025`, and `029`; amend only if current language collapses paired component facts | No projection or threshold item resolved |
| `A2M-OWNER-D002` | Replace direct calibrated-CAL input with the realized PTC-transformed intermediate; distinguish neutral PTC operation from explicitly disabled or invalid PTC; prohibit fallback | Amend `SCI-MAP-REQ-002`; align failure/provenance language in `047` and `050` as needed | No existing local decision resolved |
| `A2M-OWNER-D003` | Make PTC availability a necessary upstream fact and MAP the owner of additional named-use admission; VAL evaluates rather than authors | Amend `SCI-MAP-REQ-004`; reconcile `010`, `025`, `029`, `033`, and `035` without changing their estimator meanings | No existing local decision resolved |
| `A2M-OWNER-D004` | Require honest response state and claim-specific sufficiency without making unavailability universal map invalidity or an analysis prohibition | Amend `SCI-MAP-REQ-008`; reconcile `033`, `043`, `047`, and `050` | Narrow `SCI-MAP-OD-003` to any still-needed minimum response obligations for specifically named original-product claims |
| `A2M-OWNER-D005` | Treat later response estimates and corrected maps as immutable-parent, versioned derivatives with exact evidence/source-class/domain binding | Strengthen existing `SCI-MAP-REQ-043`, `046`, and `049`; append only if the derivative identity cannot be stated without changing an existing requirement's identity | Supports narrowing OD-003; does not decide required response generation |
| `A2M-OWNER-D006` | Disclose actual covariance meaning/domain/limitations; incomplete covariance neither invalidates the map nor forbids later analysis; later estimates are versioned attachments | Reconcile `SCI-MAP-REQ-019`, `021`, `022`, `033`, `043`, `046`, and `050` | Narrow `SCI-MAP-OD-004` to any still-required minimum original-bundle persistence/lineage choice; do not silently mark fully resolved |
| `A2M-OWNER-D007` | Assign realized coordinate facts to ALIGN/AST and target-grid/projection operation to MAP | Amend `SCI-MAP-REQ-005`; reconcile `043`--`046` | Narrow only the ownership clause of `SCI-MAP-OD-008`; projection classes, normalization, boundaries, and metadata remain open |

## Identifier Rule

The Stage B revision must preserve `SCI-MAP-REQ-001--052` and
`SCI-MAP-PRED-001--025`. Existing IDs may receive a versioned amendment when
their premise is directly superseded. Any new requirement or prediction is
append-only and must explain why no existing identifier could carry the new
obligation without changing its scientific identity.

## Deliberately Untouched Owner Questions

`SCI-MAP-OD-001`, `002`, `005`, `006`, `007`, and `009` remain unchanged.
OD-003, OD-004, and OD-008 may be narrowed only as shown in the table. No row
authorizes a decision about projection class, normalization, boundary loss,
support thresholds, publication policy, mode registration, or common-grid
preparation.
